title: Sane Was a Prolific Graffiti Tagger in NYC. Now, a Couple is Working to Keep His Legacy Alive.
summary: A Queens couple is on a quest to keep the legacy of David Smith, better known as “Sane,” alive. In the 1980s, he was one of New York City’s most-wanted vandals.
